title: Spreading a finite separable extension over a localization
statement: Let A be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field K and let K'/K be a finite separable field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. There is a nonzero c in A and a finite etale A[c^{-1}]-algebra A' [def-weil-etale-morphism] that is a domain with fraction field K'; consequently Spec(A') to Spec(A[c^{-1}]) is finite etale and surjective.
